processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Geometry-optimized crystal structure via first-principles DFT using CASTEP; GGA-PBE exchange-correlation, ultrasoft pseudopotentials, 8x8x8 Monkhorst-Pack k-point mesh, 450 eV plane-wave cutoff, energy converged to 2x10^-6 eV and forces below 0.5 eV/nm. Computational study with no experimental thermal/mechanical processing.

structures.overall_structure: Cubic B2-type supercell (space group Pm-3m) with Mn substituting Fe on the Fe sublattice of FeAl; 16-atom cell containing 8 Al, 5 Fe and 3 Mn sites.

phases_present.crystal_structure: cubic, space group Pm-3m (B2-type); a = b = c = 0.576 nm

measurement_conditions.test_standard: DFT (CASTEP, GGA-PBE) elastic constants with Voigt-Reuss-Hill (VRH) polycrystalline averaging; hardness by empirical model (Eq. 10)

electrical_properties.conductivity: metallic (nonzero DOS at Fermi level); good electronic conductivity

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: B/G = 2.03 (> 1.75), so Fe0.625Mn0.375Al is classified as ductile; by contrast FeAl (B/G = 1.56) and Fe0.875Mn0.125Al (B/G = 1.75) are brittle.

Universal anisotropic index A^U = 1.89 for Fe0.625Mn0.375Al, the third-highest anisotropy in the Fe–Mn–Al series (order: MnAl > Fe0.5Mn0.5Al > Fe0.625Mn0.375Al > Fe0.125Mn0.875Al > Fe0.375Mn0.625Al > Fe0.75Mn0.25Al > Fe0.25Mn0.75Al > Fe0.875Mn0.125Al > FeAl).

characterization_methods.technique: DFT total and partial density of states (TDOS/PDOS)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: energy range -10 to 20 eV, Fermi level at 0 eV
characterization_methods.purpose: Analyze chemical bonding characteristics and electronic structure
characterization_methods.key_findings: Panel d (Fe0.625Mn0.375Al): metallic character (nonzero DOS at Fermi level); sharp Fermi-level peak with pronounced negative down-state dip and asymmetric up/down channels (magnetic character); near Fermi level states dominated by Fe-d and Mn-d hybridized with weak Al-p states.

characterization_methods.technique: Electron density distribution and electron density difference contour maps
characterization_methods.key_findings: Combination of covalent and metallic bonds; elongated contours along Al-Fe, Al-Mn and Fe-Mn bond axes indicate covalent interactions; delocalized electrons indicate metallic bonding; leads to high melting points and high hardness.

characterization_methods.technique: Planar projections of Young's modulus on (001) and (110) crystallographic planes
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: DFT-calculated directional Young's modulus contour plots
characterization_methods.purpose: Evaluate elastic anisotropy of Young's modulus
characterization_methods.key_findings: Strong directional dependence of Young's modulus on (001) and (110) planes; non-spherical (lobed) contours indicate strong Young's-modulus anisotropy.

computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: 8x8x8 Monkhorst-Pack k-point mesh; 450 eV plane-wave cutoff; energy converged to 2x10^-6 eV; forces below 0.5 eV·nm⁻¹; valence states Fe 3d^6 4s^2, Mn 3d^5 4s^2, Al 3s^2 3p^1
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: Calculated lattice parameters show good agreement with other experimental and calculated values; slight deviation possibly from differences in calculation methods and experimental conditions.

analytical_models.model_name: Formation enthalpy and cohesive energy equations (Eqs. 1-2)
analytical_models.model_note: Formation enthalpy ΔH_f and cohesive energy E_coh computed from total energy, isolated-atom energies and bulk cohesive energies; both negative for Fe0.625Mn0.375Al.
(C11-C12)>0, C11>0, C44>0, C11+2C12>0; Fe0.625Mn0.375Al satisfies these conditions.

analytical_models.equation_role: Polycrystalline elastic moduli (B, G, E, σ)
analytical_models.model_note: Bulk modulus, shear modulus, Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio derived from single-crystal elastic constants.
H_V = 2(k^2 G)^0.585 - 3, where k = G/B (Pugh's modulus ratio).
Universal anisotropic index A^U, anisotropy A_B and A_G, shear anisotropic factors A_1=A_2=A_3.

analytical_models.model_name: Debye temperature and sound velocity equations (Eqs. 15-18)
analytical_models.equation_role: Debye temperature and sound velocity calculation
analytical_models.model_note: Average sound velocity and Debye temperature from density, bulk modulus and shear modulus.

unmapped_findings: Elastic constants of Fe0.625Mn0.375Al: C11 = 236.2 GPa, C12 = 151.1 GPa, C44 = 141.0 GPa (Table 2, b0049).
Derived moduli of Fe0.625Mn0.375Al: bulk modulus B = 179.2 GPa, shear modulus G = 88.2 GPa, Poisson's ratio σ = 0.288, B/G = 2.03 (Table 2, b0049; bulk modulus also stated in b0044).

Thermodynamic stability of Fe0.625Mn0.375Al: formation enthalpy ΔH_f = -0.347 eV·atom⁻¹ and cohesive energy E_coh = -6.868 eV·atom⁻¹ (Table 1, b0021); both negative, indicating thermodynamic stability.
Lattice parameter of Fe0.625Mn0.375Al: a = b = c = 0.576 nm (Table 1, b0021).

Elastic anisotropy of Fe0.625Mn0.375Al: universal anisotropic index A^U = 1.89, A_B = 0, A_G = 0.159, shear anisotropic factors A_1 = A_2 = A_3 = 3.31 (Table 3, b0051); third-highest A^U in the Fe–Mn–Al series (b0059).
Mechanical stability of Fe0.625Mn0.375Al: satisfies the cubic stability criteria (C11-C12 > 0, C11 > 0, C44 > 0, C11+2C12 > 0) (Eq. 3, b0033; b0034).
